fav.title: Favorites

bil.payT: Redirecting to the secure payment page…
bil.lock: If the subscription lapses, database access closes, but the account and billing stay available — renew and access returns instantly.

api.title: API & website export
api.sub: Ready-made REST API and XML feed: push listings to a client or agency website, or to portals. The format is compatible with the Hepsiemlak Partner API and Emlakjet transfer.
api.ep1: Listings: filters deal, type, il, ilce, price_min/max, rooms — paginated JSON
api.ep2: Single listing: all parameters, photos, price history
api.ep3: Full XML feed of the database, refreshed every 15 minutes
api.ep4: Webhooks: listing.created · price.changed · status.changed — events pushed to your URL

newb.title: New builds
newb.sub: Developer projects catalogue — included in your subscription together with resale.
newb.soon: This section is being filled: project cards, floor plans, developer prices and terms will appear here — structure and search are ready.
newb.watchOn: 🔔 Price and status changes — in Notifications
newb.emptyL: Nothing found — adjust or reset the filters

reqs.newAlg: The “+N new” counter shows listings that appeared for this search since you last opened it. Open the results — the counter resets.
reqs.nrNote: All realtors in the base will see the request. Owners of matching listings get notified. It expires automatically in 30 days.
reqs.nrDone: Request published — it is now in the feed
reqs.noMatch: You have no listings matching this request
reqs.feedNote: A request stays visible for 30 days, then expires automatically. Replies go to the author’s private chat — no public comments. Owners of matching listings are notified automatically.
reqs.title: Saved searches
reqs.sub: Searches you saved for your clients’ briefs: the database counts matches and notifies you about new fitting listings.
reqs.empty: Nothing yet. Set filters in Listings and press “Save search”.
reqs.note: The database is private — clients never enter it. A client tells you what they need, you save the search and send them a collection.

exp.apiSub: Push listings to any client website
exp.apiS: REST API and XML feed for your website: filtered listing queries, a full feed refreshed every 15 minutes, webhooks for new listings, price and status changes. The field format is compatible with the official Hepsiemlak Partner API (developers.hemlak.com) and Emlakjet listing transfer — once those portals connect, export switches on right here with no rework.
exp.soonT: This portal is coming soon — integration in development
exp.s: The listing is published on the selected portals under your name and stays in sync.
exp.note: Demo: portal connections are configured by the database admin.
